Sumariup data = Dye et al. survey list plus Bruce's own 1976 3-day elicitation (~550 items, p.24-25); one segmental remark (Alamblak close transition corresponds to [barred-i] in Sumariup, ch.II); Appendix pp.472-519 gives lexicostatistics (Sumariup-Alamblak 59.9%) and segmental sound-correspondence tables (Table 136, Sumariup row) -- zero hits for stress/accent/tone in the appendix; rendered pp.489, 497 confirm segmental content only.
